name: Sella
title: Keeper of the Silver Shrine
examine: Wind-braided hair and lamp-oil hands. The mother-flame behind her has burned since before the city had walls.
lines: This is the mother-flame — every road lamp in the Dawnlands is lit in its name, one wick at a time, all the way down.
My sister keeps the Last Lamp on the climb. Edda got the stubbornness; I got the altitude. We consider it a fair split.
Travelers light a thought here before the road down. The flame doesn't grant things. It just remembers you asked.
